title: Monster authoring proposal v1 — structural validation
description: Local proposed authoring only. Not an accepted WorldProject/v2 contract or runtime activation.

key.description: Namespaced authoring key. Native ProductionKey validation still applies at integration.

percent.description: Percent 0..100, in exact steps of 0.0001 percent. 0.19 means 0.19%. Convert to native ppm by multiplying by 10000.

ms.description: Positive duration/interval in milliseconds; no implicit source-unit conversion.

ratio.description: Exact rational number. Percent values represent percentage points, not fractions of one.

nonnegativePercent.description: Exact rational number. Percent values represent percentage points, not fractions of one.

conditionType.description: Canonical condition key; source aliases require an explicit import mapping.

loot.description: Only the source-supported independent base table is in this proposal. Other native algorithms retain their own accepted contracts.

document.description: Original paragraphs; no translation, correction, or paraphrase during import. Partial source text remains blocked in the import manifest.

weight_centioz.description: Proposal authoring unit: 0.01 oz. Not inferred from absent XML attributes.
